faqs.question: What does the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence and genetic material of fungi in your blood sample.

faqs.question: Why is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood done?
faqs.answer: • Identify the specific fungus causing the infection for appropriate and targeted treatment. • Monitor the effectiveness of antifungal therapy. • Detect fungal infections that are difficult to diagnose using conventional methods.

faqs.question: When is the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test may be recommended if you have • Suspected or confirmed symptoms of a fungal infection that requires diagnosis. • A compromised immune system, such as in HIV/AIDS or organ transplant patients, making you more susceptible to fungal infections. • Recurring or persistent infections despite previous treatments.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of a fungal infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood?
faqs.answer: During the test, a small sample of blood will be drawn from a vein in your arm using a needle and a syringe. The blood sample will be sent to the laboratory for analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood?
faqs.answer: To prepare for this test: • You do not need to fast or make any dietary changes before the test. • Inform your healthcare provider about any medications you are currently taking. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside the Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood include: • Fungal culture: This test grows fungi from a sample to identify the specific type of fungus causing an infection. • Antifungal susceptibility testing: This test helps determine which antifungal medications would be most effective against the identified fungal infection.

faqs.question: What is Panfungal-DNA Detection by PCR & Sanger Sequencing – EDTA Blood also known as?
faqs.answer: Panfungal Polymerase Chain Reaction and Sanger Sequencing for Fungal DNA Detection

faqs.question: What is a fungal infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal infection is a condition caused by the overgrowth or invasion of harmful fungi in the body. It can affect various parts of the body, including the skin, nails, respiratory system, and internal organs. Proper diagnosis is crucial for effective treatment.
